official_definition: Opposing Spirits/Ultimates must block if possible. When blocked, you can stack a card from your Hand onto this Spirit via Advent, without sending the 20px to the Trash.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Twinkle Clash] or [Twinkle Clash: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Twinkle Clash]", "give [Twinkle Clash]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Enforces mandatory block requirement on opposing player during block step.
